[{"node":"menu_content105","element":"menu_content","data":{"label":"Docs Online Ordering","key":"docs_online_ordering_menu_content","id":"docs_online_ordering_menu_content","name":"docs_online_ordering_menu_content"},"elements":[{"node":"markdown101","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Online and QR ordering","key":"md_online_and_qr_ordering","id":"online-and-qr-ordering","name":"md_online_and_qr_ordering","value":"# Online and QR ordering

Guests can order from their phones in two ways: **pickup** (and delivery) from your website, and **from the table** by scanning its QR code. Prices always come from the server, and only what is on the menu in force and not sold out can be ordered."}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Pickup orders","key":"md_pickup_orders","id":"pickup-orders","name":"md_pickup_orders","value":"# Pickup orders

In the **Restaurant** → *Online Ordering*:

- **Take pickup orders online**: turns on the ordering page, `/order` (with several restaurants, `/order?r=<restaurant>`). Link it from your website or social profiles; the Desk has it under **Pickup Ordering Page**.
- **Pickup orders go to**: the table where they appear for the staff, for example *Pickup* at the counter.
- **Ready in (minutes)**: the earliest pickup time offered. An order for later is held and sent to the kitchen this many minutes before its time.
- **Note for guests**: hours, allergens, parking… shown on the page.

The guest picks the items and options, gives a name and phone, and a pickup time: as soon as possible or later today. After ordering they get a page that follows the order: *Received → Preparing → Ready*.

With **Guests order delivery online** and [delivery zones](/Docs/Delivery), the same page offers delivery: the guest types the ZIP code and the right branch takes it, with its fee and minimum."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Ordering from the table","key":"md_ordering_from_the_table","id":"ordering-from-the-table","name":"md_ordering_from_the_table","value":"# Ordering from the table

- **Guests order from their table (QR)**: each table's QR code opens its menu on the guest's phone. What they order is added to the table's open order (or a new one).
- **Send table orders straight to the kitchen**: off (default), the items appear on the table as *Pending* for the server to check and **Send**. On, they go straight to the kitchen.

Print the QR codes from **Table QR Codes** in the Restaurant workspace (managers only): one card per table. If a QR code is copied or misused, open the table (**Tables** in the workspace) and use **New QR code**; the printed one stops working."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"For the staff","key":"md_for_the_staff","id":"for-the-staff","name":"md_for_the_staff","value":"# For the staff

- Online and QR orders belong to the whole team: any server can see and work them.
- They show a phone icon and the guest's name on the order tab.
- Every POS screen of the restaurant plays a sound and shows an alert when a guest places an order.
- Guests pay at the counter or to their server, as usual."}}]}]
